body.name: Rational common-confounder witness
body.construction: In one stratum, \(P^\star\) has \(p=1/2\), \(w_1=4/5\), \(w_0=1/5\), \((\mu_{1,1},\mu_{1,0})=(13/20,1/20)\), \((\mu_{0,1},\mu_{0,0})=(4/5,1/10)\), and \((\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)=(16,36,36)\).  Conditional on \((X,U)\), draw \(Y(0)\) and \(Y(1)\) as independent Bernoulli variables with these risks, and draw \(A\) from the Bayes-compatible Bernoulli law determined by \(p,w_0,w_1\).  Direct substitution gives the exact feasibility identities \(r_1=(4/5)(13/20)+(1/5)(1/20)=53/100\), \(r_0=(1/5)(4/5)+(4/5)(1/10)=6/25\), \(\pi=1/2\), \(\operatorname{OR}(w_1,w_0)=16\), \(\operatorname{OR}(13/20,1/20)=247/7<36\), and \(\operatorname{OR}(4/5,1/10)=36\).  All eight conditional Bernoulli cell probabilities are strictly between zero and one, and \(\tau(P^\star)=\{(13/20+1/20)-(4/5+1/10)\}/2=-1/10\).
